steps.en: Put a model key in backend/.env, start the backend and the frontend
steps.zh: 把模型 key 写进 backend/.env，启动后端和前端
steps.code: poetry run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 7001 · pnpm dev

steps.en: Upload a screenshot or recording, or paste a URL, and pick a stack
steps.zh: 上传截图或录屏，或粘贴网址，选好技术栈

steps.en: Streams four variants side by side, with your real images cropped in
steps.zh: 并排流式给出四个版本，用的是从原图裁出的真实图片

steps.en: Type a change, or click an element in select mode to scope it
steps.zh: 打字提修改，或在选择模式下点中元素限定范围

steps.en: Patches only what you asked and returns two fresh variants
steps.zh: 只改你要求的部分，返回两个新版本

steps.en: Copy the code, or Download Code as a ZIP with the images bundled
steps.zh: 复制代码，或下载打包了图片的 ZIP

value.en: A runnable single-file replica with your real images, refined by chat — no hand-slicing the layout or the assets
value.zh: 拿到一份带真实图片、能直接打开、可对话修改的单文件复刻页——不用手工切图、手写布局
